svg.title: Reviewer points raised by more independent first-look reviews
svg.desc: On 25 pull requests with 43 reviewer points, one first-look review raised 10.25 points before the reviewer did, on average. Any of two raised 13.7, any of three 16.0 and any of four 18.0. Three reviews merged into one draft raised 13 of the 17 they found together: +2.75 over one review, 95% interval −0.5 to +6.5.
svg.text: independent reviews at the first look
One review raised 10.2 of 43 points on average. Any of four raised 18: the
reviews differ, and each finds a few points the others miss.
Merged, it is still one message.
Three reviews merged into one draft raised 13, of the 17 the three found
between them. An agent that reviews again on every wake gains coverage
the same way, but posts each time.
+2.75 points over one review, 95% interval −0.5 to +6.5, on 25 pull requests.
The first look then costs about four times as much.
